name: Obertauern
description: Obertauern is one of Austria's most snow-sure ski resorts, offering 100 km of perfectly groomed slopes, 26 modern lifts, and a unique ski circuit. Located at 1,630–2,313 meters above sea level, Obertauern provides excellent snow conditions, a vibrant alpine village, outstanding hospitality, and unforgettable winter experiences for all skill levels.
